title: नेपाली अक्षर र अक्षर निर्धारणका आधारहरू
nepali: एक आघात वा बलमा बोलिने ध्वनि वा ध्वनि समूहलाई अक्षर भनिन्छ । अक्षरको सम्बन्ध वाणीसँग हुन्छ । स्वर र व्यञ्जन ध्वनिमध्ये स्वरध्वनिलाई अक्षरको आधार मानिन्छ । स्वरध्वनिकै आधारमा अक्षर निर्धारण गरिन्छ । शब्दको उच्चारण गर्दा मुखरता, उच्चता, शिखरता र स्पष्टताका आधारमा कति अक्षर छन् भनी निर्धारण गरिन्छ । यस लेखमा अक्षरको परिचय, अक्षरका अभिलक्षण, प्रकार, केन्द्रीय र परिधीय अवयव, नेपाली अक्षरको संरचना, नेपाली उच्चार्य र लेख्य वर्णमाला, द्विस्वर, अक्षरीकरण र अक्षर निर्धारणका आधारलाई प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ । नेपाली अक्षर र अक्षर निधार्र णका आधारलाई विभिन्न भाषा वज्ञै ानिकहरूले दिएका विचार तथा सन्दर्भ पुस्तकहरूमा छरिएर रहेका सामग्रीलाई पुस्तकालयीय अध्ययन विधिका साथै वर्णनात्मक र विश्लेषणात्मक विधिको उपयोग गरी यो लेख तयार पारिएको छ ।
american_english: A sound or group of sounds pronounced with one stress or effort is called a letter. A letter is related to speech. Among vowel and consonant sounds, the vowel sound is regarded as the basis of a letter. Letters are determined on the basis of the vowel sound itself. When a word is pronounced, it is determined how many letters there are on the basis of sonority, height, peak, and clarity. This article presents the introduction to letters, the characteristics of letters, types, central and peripheral components, the structure of Nepali letters, the Nepali spoken and written alphabet, diphthongs, transcription, and the bases for determining letters. This article was prepared using the library-study method together with descriptive and analytical methods, on the basis of the ideas given by various linguists and materials scattered in reference books on Nepali letters and the bases for determining letters.
british_english: A sound, or a group of sounds, produced with a single stress or effort is termed a letter. The letter is connected with speech. Of vowel and consonant sounds, it is the vowel sound that is regarded as the foundation of a letter. Letters are determined by the vowel sound itself. When pronouncing a word, it is determined how many letters there are on the basis of resonance, height, peak, and clarity. This article sets out the introduction to letters, the characteristics of letters, their types, central and peripheral components, the structure of Nepali letters, the Nepali spoken and written alphabet, diphthongs, transcription, and the bases on which letters are determined. The article was prepared using the library method, together with descriptive and analytical approaches, drawing upon the views offered by various linguists and upon material scattered through reference works dealing with Nepali letters and the bases on which letters are determined.
australian_english: A sound or a group of sounds said with one stress or bit of effort is what's called a letter. Letters are tied to speech. Out of vowel and consonant sounds, the vowel sound is taken as the basis of a letter. Letters get determined from the vowel sound itself. When you say a word, you work out how many letters there are from sonority, height, peak, and clarity. This piece covers the introduction to letters, the features of letters, types, central and peripheral parts, how Nepali letters are structured, the Nepali spoken and written alphabet, diphthongs, transcription, and the bases for working out letters. This piece was put together using library study along with descriptive and analytical methods, drawing on the ideas put forward by various linguists and material scattered around in reference books on Nepali letters and the bases for working out letters.
informal_english: So, a sound — or a group of sounds — that is spoken with one stress or effort is called a letter. Letters are connected with speech. Among vowel and consonant sounds, the vowel sound is taken to be the basis of a letter. Letters are decided on the basis of the vowel sound itself. When we pronounce a word, we decide how many letters there are on the basis of resonance, height, peak, and clarity. This article gives the introduction to letters, their characteristics, types, central and peripheral parts, the structure of Nepali letters, the Nepali spoken and written alphabet, diphthongs, transcription, and the bases on which letters are decided. This article has been prepared using the library study method along with descriptive and analytical methods, taking the ideas given by various linguists and material spread out in reference books on Nepali letters and the bases on which letters are decided.
